weather.lead: Orlando looks sunny and dry Saturday and Sunday with highs near 80°F. Port Canaveral stays mostly dry Monday near 76°F. Castaway Cay looks mostly sunny Tuesday with a light northeast breeze, and Lookout Cay stays near 81°F with a passing shower possible. Showers get more likely Thursday at sea, and Raleigh turns cold Friday with a high near 49°F. No tropical storms are expected; a gale low south of Bermuda is drifting east, away from our route. Forecasts past day 5 still shift, so check back here for updates.
